sections.visibleText: The | AI | -Driven Automotive Shift | The automotive industry today faces pressure from explosive autonomous vehicle data, supply chains under strain, and rising consumer expectations for intelligent in-vehicle experiences. | Alibaba Cloud's comprehensive automotive AI platform empowers manufacturers to transform these challenges into competitive advantages, delivering petabyte-scale data processing for accelerated autonomy development, predictive supply chain intelligence for operational resilience, and next-generation cockpit experiences powered by multimodal AI. Built on enterprise-grade infrastructure, our solution enables automakers to innovate faster, reduce costs, and lead in the software-defined vehicle era.

Why | Alibaba Cloud | AI Built for Automotive | Leverage Qwen models and automotive-optimized AI pipelines that accelerate perception model development, automate data labeling, and deliver ultra-low latency cockpit inference | Ecosystem Intelligence | Enrich your solutions with data and capabilities from Alibaba's logistics, navigation, and marketplace ecosystem, combined with proven deployment experience and partner integrations that generic cloud providers cannot replicate. | Operational Excellence | Unify your tooling on a single platform that dramatically reduces tool sprawl, deploys production-ready automotive AI templates in under an hour, and automates MLOps to compress model deployment from weeks to hours. | Industry-Certified Security | Operate on ISO 26262 ASIL-D compliant infrastructure with end-to-end V2X encryption, full regulatory compliance, and a dedicated automotive security operations center that meets the industry's strictest standards. | Proven Reliability and Performance | Rely on high-availability infrastructure with multi-zone redundancy, massive AI compute clusters, high-speed networking, and proven resilience at peak scale, so your critical services remain stable under heavy workloads. | Cost Optimization | Eliminate upfront capital expenditure with pay-as-you-go HPC, reduce simulation costs through intelligent spot instance scheduling, and optimize storage spending with automatic hot and cold data tiering.

sections.visibleText: Alibaba Cloud Turns Automotive Complexity into AI-Powered Advantage | Accelerate | Autonomous Driving | Innovation | The Challenge: | Autonomous driving development is slowing under the weight of explosive sensor data growth and manual workflows that stretch development timelines. How do you deliver the experience your customers expect when your infrastructure cannot scale and every cycle costs you weeks? | Our Solution: | Object Storage Service (OSS) and Data Lake Analytics ingest and preprocess petabyte-scale sensor data without infrastructure bottlenecks. AI-powered auto-labeling then transforms that data into training-ready assets, compressing annotation cycles while improving accuracy. Elastic high-performance computing clusters run millions of simulation scenarios in parallel, validating models in hours instead of weeks. Pre-trained perception models eliminate months of foundational development, so your team iterates faster and reaches autonomy milestones ahead of schedule. | Core Products: | OSS + Data Lake Analytics | PAI (Platform for AI) | E-HPC | Alibaba Cloud Model Studio | Ingests and processes massive sensor datasets with the scalability autonomous programs demand. | Learn More | Deliver Smarter, More Connected | Customer Journey | Build Resilient, Data-Driven | Supply Chains
